Only one of my three dogs will recognize things on television and she is only interested in animals in order to bark at them. I was watching Tosh.0 and there was some woman dressed as a cat with the ears, paw mittens and a tail. The dog walks by the TV and glances at the the woman and then looked away. Then my dog stopped, did the double take and started to bark at the "cat". After around 5 seconds, she decided it was a person and lost interest and walked away.

My interpretation is that the owner gave the dog a command to hide.

I was expecting the dog to jump into the TV screen, but it was very disappointing.
Unless you have a 120hz+ TV with video playback running at least 60fps your dog's won't see much more than a flashing slide show.
